description: Live evidence that the human-assisted VM bridge (LBA-REQ-045, ADR-0032) works: an automation agent drives the golden VM's interactive shell through a shared tmux session, and a real credential prompt is detected + handed off to the human WITHOUT the agent ever typing the secret.

agentDroveShell.command: echo host=$(hostname) user=$(whoami); echo labviewcli=$(command -v LabVIEWCLI)

notes: The bridge session lives on the VM (tmuxLocation=vm), so no host tmux/sudo is needed; actor has passwordless sudo on the VM to install tmux. Credentials are typed by the human in the attached pane and never transit the agent or the model.
